verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware authentication device. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is outside what this kind of product does, so the axis does not apply. The scriptable ykman CLI and the YubiEnterprise fleet REST API are device-management and building-block surfaces, not a scheduler, and the pack shows no first-party scheduling capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
